title: ProcessLight: Process Supervision for Large Language Model Based Traffic Signal Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.22746v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently been introduced into traffic signal control (TSC) as decision agents due to their strengths in human-readable reasoning generation. Yet, existing LLM TSC methods optimize only from final outcomes and fail to distinguish valid from flawed reasoning steps, causing useful or misleading steps to be jointly updated and thus impairing the model's learning of effective reasoning. To bridge this gap, we propose an LLM-based framework ProcessLight to decompose signal decisions into verifiable semantic steps. Building on ProcessLight, we further develop Step-wise Traffic Process Policy Optimization (STeP-PO), a novel reinforcement learning framework that optimizes structured reasoning processes through step-level credit assignment. translated_title: ProcessLight：基于大语言模型的交通信号控制的过程监督
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）近来因其生成人类可读推理的能力而被引入交通信号控制（TSC）领域，作为决策智能体使用。然而，现有的LLM TSC方法仅从最终结果进行优化，无法区分有效与有缺陷的推理步骤，导致有用或误导性的步骤被一起更新，从而损害了模型对有效推理的学习。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了基于LLM的框架ProcessLight，将信号决策分解为可验证的语义步骤。在ProcessLight的基础上，我们进一步开发了分步交通过程策略优化（STeP-PO），这是一种新颖的强化学习框架，通过步骤级别的信用分配来优化结构化推理过程。具体而言，STeP-PO使用步骤质量分数来评估局部推理质量，使用步骤重要性来衡量每个步骤对最终动作的影响，然后进行分配……
tldr: 提出ProcessLight框架将交通信号控制决策分解为可验证的语义步骤，并开发STeP-PO强化学习框架，通过步骤级信用分配来优化结构化推理过程，解决了现有方法仅依赖最终结果优化而无法区分有效与有缺陷推理步骤的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes ProcessLight, which decomposes traffic signal control decisions into verifiable semantic steps, and develops STeP-PO, a novel reinforcement learning framework that optimizes structured reasoning processes through step-level credit assignment, addressing the limitation of existing methods that only optimize from final outcomes.
